perception.description: The images show a rural-industrial interface with a road and adjacent farmland. The crop view details large areas of ground covered in cyan-green mesh netting interspersed with green crops and a grey building. evidence_visible: Close-up view of multiple large, irregular patches of cyan-green mesh netting laid over the ground.
